text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Heh! What do you think?! Now that you know how strong we are, hurry back to your own forest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ！　
どうだっ！
あたしたちの強さが分かったんなら、
さっさと自分の森へ帰るんだなっ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That's right. Otherwise, I'll never be able to recover...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのとおりですわ。
さもないと
一生再起不能に……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Where did all that energy go? He turned tail and ran off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら？　
先ほどまでの威勢はどこへやらですね？
尻尾を巻いて逃げて行きましたわ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: You must have realized that monsters are dangerous on instinct, too...
text_block_list.orig_text: 魔物も本能でヤバイやつだって気づいたんだろ……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: A dangerous person...? Who are you talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤバイ奴……？　
誰のことですか？
